# FatalityDrivenPruning

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
The selective removal of nodes (and their incident edges) due to high fatality rates, leading to topological fragmentation or hub loss. Mimics cascading failures in high-performance computing interconnects, aiding in the design of fault-tolerant topologies.
